claims.claim: Atlas experienced a 22-minute service interruption on July 7.
claims.evidence: Atlas experienced a 22-minute service interruption on July 7.

claims.claim: An expired TLS certificate prevented an internal service from communicating with the loan processing service.
claims.evidence: The incident investigation determined that an expired TLS certificate prevented one of the application's internal services from communicating with the loan processing service.

claims.claim: Engineering renewed the certificate and restored normal service.
claims.evidence: Engineering renewed the certificate and restored normal service.

claims.claim: The incident review identified the expired TLS certificate as the root cause of the outage.
claims.evidence: The incident review identified the expired TLS certificate as the root cause of the outage.

claims.claim: Platform Engineering added automated certificate expiration monitoring after the incident.
claims.evidence: Following the incident, Platform Engineering added automated certificate expiration monitoring.

claims.claim: The incident involved the loan processing service, related to Product Lending.
